subject: Discovery recap: Migration off proprietary LLM APIs - AcmeAI
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@acmeai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 17:12:00 -0500
Subject: Discovery recap: Migration off proprietary LLM APIs - AcmeAI

Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and next steps so we stay aligned. If I missed anything, please flag it.

Key pain points you called out:
- Rising costs and vendor lock: heavy spend on OpenAI/Anthropic for production prompt traffic and concerns over price increases and rate limits.
- Latency spikes for peak batch jobs impacting user-facing product flows.
- Data governance: need VPC/on-prem options and clear audit logs for regulatory audits.

Current stack (what you shared):
- Frontend: customer-facing chat + search features (React)
- Backend: microservices on AWS (EKS) calling OpenAI/Anthropic for generation + embeddings
- Orchestration: internal queueing + a small proxy for routing to model vendors

Success criteria for a migration project:
1) Maintain or improve 95th percentile latency on prompt flows
2) 20–30% reduction in per-token inference costs within 3 months of rollout
3) No user-visible regressions in quality for primary intents (support triage, summarization, FAQ retrieval)
4) Ability to run in VPC with KMS integration and audit logging for compliance

Compatibility & technical constraints you mentioned:
- Need GPT-compatible inference interface (prompt/temperature/stop sequence semantics)
- Embeddings must be within 5% cosine similarity of current vectors for retrieval recall (we'll validate with eval set)
- Must support streaming responses for the chat UX

Model shortlist we discussed (initial):
- Open models: Llama 3 family (quantized variants), Mistral, RedPajama derivatives
- Managed/open-hosted variants that Redwood verifies for perf/cost

Suggested next steps:
- I will send a Mutual Action Plan (attached) with timelines and milestones for a small pilot (two endpoints: chat generation + embeddings).
- You to share the 200–300 example prompts/queries and an embeddings evaluation set (we can run a small compatibility test).
- Schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive with your infra lead + our runtime engineer next week.

Attachments: AcmeAI-Mutual-Action-Plan-v1.pdf, SOC2-Summary-Redwood.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.
—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0104

From: Alex Green <alex.green@acmeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmeai.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 20:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Migration off proprietary LLM APIs - AcmeAI

Thanks Marissa — this looks right. A few clarifications and items from our side: 

- Good summary on costs. Our current blended per-token spend is ~$0.0009/token after volume discounts; target is to get under $0.0006/token ideally.
- On latency: 95th percentile for our chat path is ~420ms today; the hard requirement is <=450ms, but we want to aim lower.
- For embeddings, we'll export a 10k-row eval CSV; I'll put that in the shared folder. Can Redwood run a recall/similarity comparison as part of the pilot?

Technical questions:
1) For GPT-compatible semantics, will Redwood provide a compatibility shim so we don't need to change client-side code?
2) For streaming: does the Dedicated/private runtime support chunked streaming to our frontend over websockets?

Next steps from AcmeAI: 
- I'll upload the prompt set and embeddings eval by EOD Thursday (Nov 5).
- Priya (cc'd) will coordinate infra availability for a deep-dive on Tuesday 11/10.
- Legal will request an initial SOW template (looping in legal@acmeai.com).

Appreciate the SOC2 doc — helps our security review.

Best,
Alex
Head of Product
AcmeAI
alex.green@acmeai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@acmeai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmeai.com>, legal@acmeai.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Migration off proprietary LLM APIs - AcmeAI

Alex — thanks, great notes. Short replies inline: 

> Our current blended per-token spend is ~$0.0009/token after volume discounts; target is to get under $0.0006/token ideally.

Yes — that target is achievable for many workloads with quantized open models + batching/caching. We will include a cost projection in the MAP.

> For embeddings, we'll export a 10k-row eval CSV; I'll put that in the shared folder. Can Redwood run a recall/similarity comparison as part of the pilot?

Yes — we'll run the similarity & retrieval recall tests against the eval set as part of the pilot and share the results in the deep-dive. Please include expected retrieval metrics (precision@k / recall) you currently observe.

> For GPT-compatible semantics, will Redwood provide a compatibility shim so we don't need to change client-side code?

Short answer: yes. Our API supports a GPT-compatible surface with minor mapping for a couple of parameters (we'll document exact mappings). For Dedicated/Private deployments there's a small adapter that sits in the proxy layer to preserve existing client calls.

> For streaming: does the Dedicated/private runtime support chunked streaming to our frontend over websockets?

Yes — streaming is supported. For Dedicated/private we can do streaming over websocket or server-sent events; we'll discuss tradeoffs on the technical call and confirm with your infra team.

Next steps / timeline: 
- Acme to upload prompts + embeddings eval by EOD Thu 11/05 (Alex).
- I'll schedule the technical deep dive for Tue 11/10 10:00–11:00 PT with Rishi and Aditya from our side.
- I'll send an updated MAP with cost projection and pilot success criteria by EOD Fri 11/06.

Attachments: AcmeAI-Mutual-Action-Plan-v1.pdf, SOC2-Summary-Redwood.pdf

If legal wants an SOW template, Rishi can share a canonical SOW and our standard terms.

Talk soon —
Marissa
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0104
